doc.title: Joe Wilder — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Les Hite and his band's style
summary: A commercial, Midwest dance band led by a low-key, nice man.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: What was he like as a bandleader? What was Les Hite like? What was the character of his band?

It wasn’t an out-and-out swing band. It was a sort of a Midwest – like a commercial-type band, more or less. They played some nice swing things, but they also played things that people liked to dance to. He was a nice man, Les was. Les was a nice – very low key, really nice man.
